_note: Four pixel-aligned layers for the banc-explorer panel. Every layer renders with the identical camera from walking_steering_camera.json at 1600x1200, transparent, full canvas preserved, so they stack exactly.
_sides: DNa02 left/right were not given and are not in the repo. Resolved from CAVE cell_info (datastack brain_and_nerve_cord, mat 896) then sided by mesh geometry, calibrated on the DNa01 pair whose sides were given. Brain-end centroid x: DNa01 left 563857 nm, DNa01 right 411099 nm, midline 487478 nm. Each DNa02 landed within ~12k nm of its same-side DNa01, which is the check that this is right.
_colors: The base is neutral gray so the action layers read against it. Action layers keep the scene semantics: #ff1493 descending, #089c39 ascending.

context-base.description: all 154 neurons, neutral gray, always visible

forward.description: the six forward-walking cells: DNg100 pair, AN09B029_b pair, AN02A002 pair

backward.label: MOONWALK
backward.description: the four BANC MDNs mapped by soma supervoxel from materialization 896 to the frozen v888 public mesh snapshot

turn-left.description: left DNa01 and DNa02, both descending

turn-right.description: right DNa01 and DNa02, both descending

eat.label: EATING
eat.description: six feeding exemplars: DNg70, feeding-associated DNp44, hunger-associated DNp62

threat-walk.label: THREAT RESPONSE
threat-walk._label_note: THREAT RESPONSE, never 'threat detection'. These cells sit in the response module influenced by loom and small-object pathways; they are not themselves a complete visual detection circuit.
threat-walk.description: five escape-on-foot exemplars: DNp42 backward walking, DNg55 steering, DNge053 walking. DNp01/02/04/06 deliberately excluded as takeoff, for a later flight layer.

flight-dodge-dnp03-all.label: QUICK DODGE / FLIGHT SACCADE
flight-dodge-dnp03-all._role: flight-saccade response; NOT threat detection. Do not label these threat detectors.
flight-dodge-dnp03-all.description: DNp03 both hemispheres, resolved in BANC v888 cell_info

flight-dodge-dnp03-anatomical-left.label: QUICK DODGE, ANATOMICAL LEFT
flight-dodge-dnp03-anatomical-left._naming: anatomical side, NOT a behavioural direction. Do not rename dodge-left until the behavioural mapping is independently validated.

flight-dodge-dnp03-anatomical-right.label: QUICK DODGE, ANATOMICAL RIGHT
flight-dodge-dnp03-anatomical-right._naming: anatomical side, NOT a behavioural direction.

groom-head-dng12.label: BANC DNg12-annotated population - anterior grooming
groom-head-dng12._qualifier: This is the BANC-native DNg12 annotation population. It does not imply that every rendered cell was independently function-tested.
groom-head-dng12.description: 28 cells with cell_info tag == DNg12 at materialization 888. Subtype-only DNg12_a/DNg12_b rows deliberately NOT unioned in; the two contradictory a/b cells were never in this set so the exclusion was a no-op.

walk-speed-dng100.description: DNg100 pair alone, walking speed. Deliberately excludes DNa01, DNa02, AN09B029_b and AN02A002: the app composites this as an independent layer over forward / turn-left / turn-right while SPEED is held.

flight-power-dng02.label: FLIGHT POWER / THROTTLE
flight-power-dng02._role: Both flight-forward and flight-reverse reuse this same anatomical layer. Reverse is a reduced/redirected-thrust UI state, NOT a separate backward-flight cell type. Do not render or label S as different cells.
flight-power-dng02.description: 26-cell BANC DNg02 population from app/data/flight-dng02.json, v888

flight-steer-mnb1-all._caveat: Anatomical side is not assigned to turn direction; b1 output is graded and phase-dependent.
